configuration.precision: Same FP16 artifact with FP32 layer_norm policy; backend arithmetic may differ
configuration.prefix_cache: disabled; zero KV cache before every request
configuration.decoding: Shared HF float32 greedy teacher-forced trace; 64 decode inputs and 65 reference logits
configuration.engine_timer: Synchronous MLModel.prediction only; full-logit diagnostics excluded from every timed trial
configuration.request_timer: Warm in-process cache reset, input preparation, synchronous prediction, native cache handoff and full-vocabulary greedy argmax; no printing, diagnostics, token detokenization, HTTP or UI
configuration.ttft: Warm in-process request start through first greedy token selection; excludes model loading/compilation
configuration.prefill_rate: Actual prompt token count / prompt prediction duration; static input width remains 64
configuration.order: Four-row balanced Latin square; one backend loaded per block, each prompt trial individually prewarmed
configuration.quality_gate: Per-prompt HF replay: finite logits, zero top1 mismatches, max KL <= 0.01 nats; does not establish general accuracy
configuration.comparison_scope: CoreML backend configurations on identical graph; not isolated hardware peaks or Orion/oMLX ranking
